title: Coco the Penguin Finds a Friend

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who lives far, far away, where it is very, very cold?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who wears a black and white coat, and walks like this? Waddle, waddle! Can you guess?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's... a penguin!

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: Hello! I'm Coco the penguin!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hi, Coco! I'm Super Bobo! Brrr! It's so cold here!

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: This is my home. Ice and snow, all around!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What sound does a penguin make?

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: Squawk! Squawk!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you squawk like Coco? Your turn!

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: Squawk! Squawk!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And how does a penguin walk? Waddle, waddle, waddle!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Let's waddle together! Waddle, waddle!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Penguins waddle, because their legs are short!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's learn three penguin facts!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact one. Penguins are birds, but they can't fly.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Can't fly? Oh no!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: But penguins are super swimmers! Their wings are flippers. Swish, swish!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact two. Penguins slide on their tummies, on the ice. Wheee!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: I want to try! Wheee! Oops!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact three. Emperor penguin daddies keep the egg warm, on their feet!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: On their feet? Wow! A warm, cozy egg!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: But Coco had a problem.

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: All the other penguins are playing together. But I'm all alone.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Coco felt lonely, and a little shy.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Why don't you play with them, Coco?

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: I'm too shy. What can I say?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How can Coco make a friend? What do you think?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: I know! Just say: Hello! Can I play with you?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Look! There is a little penguin, all by himself. His name is Pip.

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Hmm. I want to build a snow tower. But it keeps falling down.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Coco took a big, deep breath.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you take a big breath, like Coco? In... and out.

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: Hello! I'm Coco. Can I play with you?

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Yes, please! Can you help me build my tower?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Coco and Pip built the tower together. One block,

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: two blocks,

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: three blocks!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Our tower is so tall! We did it together!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Then, whoosh! The wind blew Pip's blue scarf into the water!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Oh no! My scarf!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who can help Pip? Who is a super swimmer?

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: I can! Penguins are super swimmers!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Coco dived into the water. Splash! Swish, swish, swish!

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: Here's your scarf, Pip!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Thank you, Coco! You are my best friend!

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: Best friends! Hooray!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Coco found a friend! Say hello, play together, and help each other.

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Now Coco and Pip slide together. Wheee!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Wait for me! Wheee!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's remember!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can a penguin fly?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: No! But penguins are super swimmers!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How do penguins slide on the ice?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: On their tummies! Wheee!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Where do emperor penguin daddies keep the egg warm?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: On their feet!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What did Coco say, to make a friend?

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: Hello! Can I play with you?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And what sound does a penguin make?

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: Squawk! Squawk!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Say it with Coco and Pip!

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: Say hello!

vo.speaker: pip
vo.text: Play together!

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: Help each other!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Say hello. Play together. Help each other!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Let's waddle one more time! Waddle, waddle, waddle!

vo.speaker: coco
vo.text: Bye-bye, friends! Squawk, squawk!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time!
